target.title: fix(msteams): cap team-group-id cache with pruneMapToMaxSize
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `teamGroupIdCache` Map in `resolveTeamGroupId` had TTL-based expiry (10 min) but no size cap. A large Teams workspace with many distinct team IDs could accumulate entries faster than the TTL window, allowing unbounded growth.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a 500-entry cap via `pruneMapToMaxSize` — the shared SDK helper already used by 11 other files. The cap is applied after each successful cache insert. Same pattern as #101650.

## User Impact

No change for normal usage. Memory usage bounded at ~500 entries regardless of workspace size.

## Evidence

- `npx oxlint extensions/msteams/src/graph-thread.ts` — 0 errors
- `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` — 11 files already using the same helper (Discord, Nextcloud Talk, Slack, gateway, etc.)
- Existing TTL expiry (10 min) handles normal eviction; the cap is a safety net for heavy usage bursts
